notes.title: Update - Demo Build v0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Demo build v0.2 is live![/h1]
This update contains a decent amount of changes, which I'll do my best to outline below. As always, feedback encouraged! There's a feedback button in the game menu which links to a Google form. Feel free to post in the community hub as well. Bug reporting is also much appreciated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355702/ad0767e7465a1a4bc0315acd88ac8ab8122af970.gif[/img]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Demo Format[/h3]
[list]
[*]Worlds can now be played for unlimited days
[*]Season length changed from 10 to 25 days
[/list]

[h3]Settlers[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added settler stats: [u]Efficiency[/u], [u]Immunity[/u], and [u]Devotion[/u].
[*]Added daily resource needs: [u]Food[/u], [u]Medicine[/u], and [u]Influence[/u]
[*]Added conditions: [u]Hunger[/u], [u]Health[/u], and [u]Devotion[/u]
[*]Added [u]Diseases[/u], which can be contracted by settlers with low [u]Health[/u]
[*]Added the [u]Coup[/u] event, which is started by settlers with low [u]Devotion[/u]
[*]Removed settler [u]Happiness[/u]
[/list]

[h3]Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [u]Medicine[/u] resources, which are consumed to keep settler [u]Health[/u] high
[*][u]Trees[/u] now regrow
[*][u]Flax[/u] now regrows
[*]Some [u]Medicine[/u] resources regrow
[*]Resource spawn rates changed
[/list]

[h3]Structures[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [u]Wood Bridge[/u]
[*]Added [u]Mushroom Cellar[/u]
[*]Added [u]Purple Mushroom Cellar[/u]
[*]Added [u]Jammery[/u]
[*]Removed [u]Kitchen[/u]
[*][u]Gardening Shed[/u] now must be placed on existing [u]Fertile Soil[/u]
[*][u]Explorer Tent[/u] area reduced; auto-packs when area clear
[*]Reworked [u]Tavern[/u] and [u]Town Hall[/u]
[*]Many structure build requirements changed
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*][u]Winter[/u] now prevents many resources from growing
[*]Month length shortened to 25 days
[*][u]Harvest[/u] structures now highlight resources in range
[*]Added [u]Info Hover[/u] to resources
[*]Added [u]Info Tooltip[/u] when building
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Signups Open Once Again!
notes.content:
Hey all! I just pushed a new build to the playtest, and I'm looking for some more testers before publishing to the public demo. There are a decent amount of new changes to check out! I posted version notes on the playtest page, so be sure to check them out once you are accepted. Thanks!

-rick

notes.title: Settler's Domain Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
The first iteration of testing has begun! This is an exciting time as the game has only ever been tested by a small pool of people (so there are likely many bugs). The game is in a basic state, but is playable and needs feedback as well as bug reporting. I'll be giving players access incrementally, with total numbers depending on how many sign up.

Feedback is extremely important! Here is a quick Google form where I'll be collecting general feedback about the playtest: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfAC4PIHnRunKwxreMTnQ1XgAAEv7yyHoe_4mANkfYktFZ0Ig/viewform?usp=sharing]Settler's Domain Playtest General Feedback[/url]

If you encounter a bug, instead please send a screenshot and/or description to this email: settlersdomaingame@gmail.com


I appreciate any feedback, and thanks so much for wishlisting and participating in the playtest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355702/ad0767e7465a1a4bc0315acd88ac8ab8122af970.gif[/img]
